audience: pet grooming and pet care businesses that run appointments and customers in MoeGo

useCases.title: See tomorrow's appointments and the pets
useCases.text: List the appointments for a time range. Open one to read its pets, services, staff and amounts.

useCases.title: Review a customer, the pets and the notes
useCases.text: Find a customer by phone number. Read the contact data, the pets with vaccinations and the staff notes.

useCases.title: Find the orders that are not paid yet
useCases.text: List orders by status for a period. Open one order to read totals and tips. Check the payments of the order.

useCases.title: Check which online booking slots are open
useCases.text: Read the dates and times that clients can book online for a location. This tool books nothing.

useCases.title: Pull a business report for a period
useCases.text: List the reports that exist for the company. Fetch the table data of one report for a time period.

useCases.title: Add a note to a customer profile
useCases.text: Add one staff note to a customer, for example a grooming preference. The tool adds a note and does not replace old notes.
